title: Nixie Tube
subtitle: Aging circuitry? A faulty connection? Or perhaps ...

items.text: Nixie Tube
Somewhere in the Suitcase
In the hall, a slender plant stands, with green flower buds clinging to its stalk.
Its branches sway in a metered rhythm.

items.speaker: Oliver Fog
items.text: Here's what happened.

items.speaker: Oliver Fog
items.text: A few days ago, I asked A Knight to tell me the story of Pepin the Short.

items.speaker: Oliver Fog
items.text: So I knocked on the door to his room, but no one answered. Then I went to check the patio, but he wasn't there either.

items.speaker: Oliver Fog
items.text: Next, I asked Vertin, but … She didn't know either.

items.speaker: An-an Lee
items.text: Ah! I understand, Sir Fog! So you want to know where Sir Knight has gone.

items.speaker: An-an Lee
items.text: Well, it is true I am the very best when it comes to ghost hunting! But Sir Knight is not exactly a ghost. He's more of a haunting character …

items.speaker: Oliver Fog
items.text: Apologies, I suppose I don't quite understand your arcane skill, but … perhaps you still have a knack for finding people.
Oliver Fog fishes out a few Sharpodonties from his pocket.

items.speaker: Oliver Fog
items.text: This is work. I know the rules.

items.speaker: Oliver Fog
items.text: I did not prepare much, but maybe I can pay a deposit first.

items.speaker: An-an Lee
items.text: Huh? What's this?
It dawns on her.

items.speaker: An-an Lee
items.text: Oh, how generous! In that case, I'll certainly help you.

items.speaker: An-an Lee
items.text: Besides catching ghosts, asking Lord Lao Zi for a little direction is a simple matter …
She takes the two pieces from Oliver's hand.

items.speaker: An-an Lee
items.text: And it is a kind gesture to help out a friend …

items.speaker: An-an Lee
items.text: Hm, what was it that Grandma taught me again?

items.speaker: An-an Lee
items.text: Whatever. As long as you truly believe it, that's all that matters!
An-an Lee cups three arcade tokens in her hands, clasping them together and shaking them forcefully.

items.speaker: An-an Lee
items.text: Spirits of heaven and earth …

items.speaker: Oliver Fog
items.text: At first, I thought A Knight might have been on a mission outside … So, I specifically asked Ms. Vertin.

items.speaker: Oliver Fog
items.text: But Ms. Vertin said that A Knight hasn't been on any missions recently.

items.speaker: Oliver Fog
items.text: But he had asked Vertin for several days of leave.

items.speaker: Oliver Fog
items.text: I wonder if he has some important matters to attend to?

items.speaker: An-an Lee
items.text: Hm … yes, I see him!
The young ghost hunter begins her soothsaying.

items.speaker: An-an Lee
items.text: I see that Sir Knight is as he was before. He still loves telling those dreadful jokes.

items.speaker: An-an Lee
items.text: But—it seems he has been collecting something recently! They look like small colorful banners and trumpets …

items.speaker: An-an Lee
items.text: It's not clear to me what he's doing!
She stops her hands and examines the answer the coins give.

items.speaker: An-an Lee
items.text: Hmm …

items.speaker: An-an Lee
items.text: The first hexagram, Lesser Yin; the second hexagram, Lesser Yang …

items.speaker: An-an Lee
items.text: The sixth hexagram, Old Yin ... Changing to the Hexagram of Earth over Water.
An-an Lee falls silent.

items.speaker: An-an Lee
items.text: Oh, ho!
She has learned her grandma's exaggerated manner of shouting.

items.speaker: An-an Lee
items.text: Oh dear, that's terrible, Sir Fog!

items.speaker: Oliver Fog
items.text: What does all of this mean?

items.speaker: An-an Lee
items.text: The Hexagram of Earth over Water shows that Sir Knight is going to war and that the war will be both unpredictable and hazardous.

items.speaker: An-an Lee
items.text: And this changing of the Hexagram shows ... there may be traitors among Sir Knight's forces, so he must be extra cautious.

items.speaker: Oliver Fog
items.text: Going to war?

items.speaker: Oliver Fog
items.text: In the suitcase?

items.speaker: Oliver Fog
items.text: This sounds rather more like a tall tale …

items.speaker: An-an Lee
items.text: Hmm ... The war indicated in the hexagram isn't some mere skirmish.
The branches of the potted plant stop their rhythm and begin to tremble.
And though perhaps it is only old circuits, the fluorescent lights in the hall begin to flicker faintly.
The orange light in the vision pulses slowly, like twilight in a memory.

items.speaker: Oliver Fog
items.text: Perhaps …
The pair look at each other.

items.speaker: Oliver Fog
items.text: … Ms. An-an, do you know what era it is outside right now?
TO BE CONTINUED…
